title: glosa dialogue table row
description: tier: Dr (specified; independently unreviewed). Implements templates/knowledge/dialogue_table.md (S14, founder 35c): one row per source, placed by how it talks to OUR problem/hypothesis -- never by who came first, never 'seminal'/'pioneering' (date is metadata only, never row order). A stance (agrees/disagrees) may only be recorded once the backing citation_card's claim_match_verified is true. Namespace https://glosa.example/ is a placeholder.

stance.description: Renders the template's paired 'agrees with H'/'disagrees with H' columns as one typed field; ORTHOGONAL means neither supports nor challenges H (different question), UNDETERMINED means the passage was ambiguous or not fully read -- never silently rounded to a stance.

defeater_class.description: design/SESSION_ARCH_v0.4_SPEC.md §10.1 (lrs.dialogue-table-claim-type-column, build_now). Renders templates/knowledge/dialogue_table.md's `defeater_class` column: the sources/notes/EPISTEMIC_FUSION_v8.1.txt:30-72 five-way claim-type separation. Deliberately NOT named `claim_type` -- that name is already a schema-fixed enum on claim_card.yaml routing kernel rule16w; reusing it here would collide with a different, already-wired field. Schema-optional by design: a row with a stance (YES/NO) and this field blank still validates -- the template documents the stance-without-defeater-class check as a LINT, not a hard schema gate (`INCOMPLETE: dialogue_table row has a stance ... but no defeater_class/legitimate_defeater`), mechanically enforced by `cli/glosa`'s `_dialogue_row_incomplete`/`glosa lit table` (`rows_incomplete_defeater`), not by this schema's `required`.

legitimate_defeater.description: design/SESSION_ARCH_v0.4_SPEC.md §10.1 (lrs.dialogue-table-claim-type-column, build_now). Free text naming what would actually defeat THIS ROW's agrees/disagrees stance, matching `defeater_class`'s style (e.g. `empirical` wants a contrary-evidence/replication falsifier, not an absence/misdescription-style one -- kernel.glosa_kernel.rule30, a different-artifact/different-namespace sibling of this column). Schema-optional by design -- see `defeater_class`'s description; enforced as a lint by `cli/glosa`, not a schema `required`.

allOf.description: A stance other than UNDETERMINED requires claim_match_verified true (template's forbidden-list rule: never write a stance for a row whose citation_card is not claim_match_verified).
